title.en: Indhiya Thesiya Raanuvaththil Thamizhar Pangu (இந்திய தேசிய இராணுவத்தில் தமிழர் பங்கு)

text.en: Tamils stood shoulder to shoulder with Netaji in the fight for freedom.

The Indian National Army (INA) was formed for India's freedom, and Tamils were its pillars. The lesson by Ma. Su. Annamalai describes the role of Tamils who fought alongside Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose in the INA and kept the freedom struggle's light burning.
It shows that the fight for freedom included people from all regions and that sacrifice for the nation matters.
Terms: இந்திய தேசிய இராணுவம் (INA), விடுதலைப் போராட்டம் (freedom struggle), நேதாஜி and தியாகம் (sacrifice).
